method: Read-only GETs to each built-in Blockscout-API history endpoint and read-only eth_calls to a public Ethereum node, made by a script written for this audit; nothing submitted. For the burn address 0x…dead, which holds burned NFTs on every network: the ERC-721 and ERC-1155 transfer lists, the fungible transfer list (whether NFT rows appear in it), and Blockscout's REST v2 NFT inventory with its second page. Then ERC-165 answers for an ERC-721, an ERC-1155 and an ERC-20 contract, ownerOf for an existing and a missing token, and an ERC-1155 balanceOf.

notes: base, arbitrum, polygon and arbitrum-sepolia Blockscout instances answered every request from this machine, the existing txlist and tokentx included, with a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403, cf-mitigated: challenge); nothing NFT-specific was learned from them.
Blockscout writes null for a collection's tokenName and tokenSymbol when it has none, and Routescan's token1155tx rows carry no tokenDecimal; both shapes are parsed.
No tokentx answer carried a tokenID; two carried an empty tokenDecimal for a fungible token, which is why a tracked token's own decimals scale its rows.
